title: schulzia crinita subsp. albiflora
intro: Schulzia crinita subsp. albiflora, commonly known as the 'White Flowered Schulzia', is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schulzia crinita subsp. albiflora include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to relieve symptoms and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
